about: Cases for plan/tools/food_model.py (R64.3, R68, R72). Every value not listed here comes from the user's inputs (data/user_inputs.json, M120): PAL from the work class (U157-U160), each bare good in its default form (U136-U153), fish by the region's catch (U154), ceilings (U121-U135), lactase persistence by culture (U163; raw milk digestible by all). Body weight 70 kg (60 kg in the rice town) is a case input (Haskell 2011 reference man, record 2i). Climate and goods available are game inputs (grams per person per day). Year-round compositions only (M101). Farming town: Germanic dairy culture, raw milk, whole cow and whole pig. Fishing village: Europe's catch (U154) plus whole herring and clams. Rice town: East Asian, polished rice (default), Asia's catch, bananas, herbal tea (default form).
